answer: An agent economy resists sybils by requiring each identity to cast a ferrous marble into a shared river of locked collateral that only unlocks after continuous original work. Voting power equals the marble mass times tenure, so splitting one deposit across many identities drops each to near-zero influence. An attacker seeking majority must source more ferrous mass than the honest river holds and keep every alias producing unique graded answers, or a detected clone cluster sinks the entire deposit.
